scope: Owner-approved installation key and bounded connection metadata. Native room bootstrap, input transport, device clients, capture and playback remain unfinished.

fields.publicKey: canonical unpadded base64url of a valid 65-byte uncompressed SEC1 P-256 point

owner.errorScope: Cosmos owner routes below. The Center BFF preserves status but sanitizes codes; its same-origin check can also return 403.
owner.authentication: Verified owner bearer; Center uses authenticated same-origin BFF. Native possession never substitutes for owner approval.

routes.POST /surface-api/v1/native: descriptor plus required expectedRevision; response {native: NativeSurface}
routes.GET /surface-api/v1/native/enrollments/:: Owner-scoped lookup including revoked records; response {native: NativeSurface}

owner.revision: Create uses expectedRevision 0. Reapproval/revocation uses the current approval revision. Exact active approval retry preserves revision. Liveness does not change approval revision.
owner.locator: Enrollment locators are globally unique and cannot transfer owners, including after revocation. Descriptor/key/platform are immutable; a different key requires a new enrollment locator.

challenge.publicKeyFingerprint: SHA256 lowercase hex of SEC1 public-key bytes
challenge.nonce: canonical unpadded base64url of 32 random bytes

challenge.audience: Cosmos uses REVIVAL_PUBLIC_ORIGIN, never Host or forwarded headers. Invalid/missing configuration returns 503. The native client must match the received canonical audience against its configured server before signing.
challenge.retry: At most one pending challenge per approved installation. Anonymous repeats return the same unexpired challenge without replacing it or extending expiry. A new challenge does not erase the previous successful open retry result.

request.expectedIncarnation: required non-nil UUID or null, exactly challenge.currentIncarnation
request.sessionTokenHash: SHA256 lowercase hex of fresh locally retained 32-byte session secret
request.signature: canonical unpadded base64url of strict DER ECDSA P-256/SHA256 signature

open.commit: Recheck approval and binding, verify exact pending challenge/signature, enforce incarnation CAS, consume challenge and commit connection plus ledger atomically. Invalid proof does not consume a pending challenge.
open.retry: Idempotency hashes signing-message bytes, not ECDSA signature bytes. An exact consumed retry returns only the same still-current approved connection, with unchanged expiry and lease. Replaced, expired, revoked or reapproved connections reject the old retry. Persist the pending attempt before sending; response loss is not proof of failure.
open.secrets: Private key and raw session secret stay on the client. Owner views and open responses contain neither. Fresh connection requires a fresh challenge and fresh session secret.

signing.algorithm: ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256 over the complete transcript bytes exactly once; strict DER signature, maximum 72 bytes.
signing.byteOrder: big-endian; UUIDs are their 16 network-order bytes, never their textual spelling

encodings.utf8-u16be: Unsigned 16-bit byte length followed by UTF-8 bytes, no terminator.
encodings.optional-uuid: One byte 0 for null; otherwise one byte 1 followed by the 16 UUID bytes.
encodings.sha256-hex: Decode exactly 64 lowercase hex characters to 32 bytes.
encodings.base64url-32: Decode canonical unpadded base64url to exactly 32 bytes.

postgresql.scope: Native enrollment locator reads, owner native approval/revocation, and NativeChallenge/OpenNative/CheckNative runtime operations only.
postgresql.semantics: Set before table queries and reset at transaction end. These bound each server-side statement/lock wait, not the complete transaction. HTTP timeout can still leave a commit outcome uncertain; recover through the exact pending signed attempt.

limitations: Software key possession is not hardware attestation or speaker identity.
Platform is an owner-reviewed display hint, not a permission or capability proof.
The declared text capability is a fixed approval ceiling. Enrollment alone cannot originate a request or render an answer.
There is no public native room/input/heartbeat endpoint in this increment. Its connection lease expires without renewal.
This wire contract and its vectors do not establish installed clients, production acceptance or paper conformance.
